description:
Pediped makes premium children's footwear designed as the "next best thing to bare feet". Founded by parents, our shoes are pediatrician-approved (APMA Seal), ultra-flexible, comfortable, stylish, and built for healthy foot development from infants to big kids.

What Makes Us Different

  • Flexible soles that support natural foot growth
  • Premium, safe non-toxic materials
  • Excellent traction & durability parents trust
  • Stylish designs kids actually want to wear

How You Earn

Earn 15% commission on every sale through your unique link (30-day cookie). High average order value + repeat buyers = great earning potential for mom influencers, parenting bloggers, and content creators.

Easy Ways to Promote

  • Instagram/TikTok reels & stories
  • Blog reviews & gift guides
  • Pinterest pins
  • Email newsletters & parent Facebook groups

Quick approval • Dedicated support • Promote shoes that actually make a difference for kids' feet!

The minimum amount you can request is $100.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to the pediped® Affiliate Program!

Thank you for joining our affiliate community. These Terms & Conditions govern your participation in the pediped® Affiliate Program ("Program"). By applying for or participating in the Program, you agree to comply with these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, you may not participate in the Program.

1. Affiliate Application Approval

pediped® reserves the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at its sole discretion. Approval into the Program is not guaranteed, and pediped® is not obligated to provide a reason for rejecting an application.

2. Affiliate Links & Coupon Codes

Each approved affiliate will receive a unique affiliate link. Affiliates may also generate links to specific products or collections through the affiliate dashboard.

If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links before making a purchase, the most recently clicked eligible affiliate link will receive credit.

Some affiliates may be assigned a unique promotional coupon code. Coupon availability, terms, and usage will be specified in the affiliate dashboard.

  • Orders will only earn one affiliate commission.
  • If a customer both clicks an affiliate link and uses the affiliate's assigned coupon code, only one commission will be awarded.
  • Affiliates may not advertise, distribute, or promote coupon codes that have not been specifically assigned to them.

Affiliates may promote pediped® through approved online and offline marketing channels, including websites, blogs, social media platforms, email newsletters where permitted, magazines, and other approved advertising methods.

3. Commissions & Payments

Affiliates earn commissions on qualifying purchases made through their approved affiliate links or assigned coupon codes according to the current commission structure.

Commission calculations are based on the eligible product subtotal and do not include:

  • Taxes
  • Shipping charges
  • Gift cards
  • Additional fees
  • Discounts

Orders Not Eligible for Commission

The following orders do not qualify for affiliate commissions:

  • Wholesale orders
  • Distributor or reseller purchases
  • Bulk or corporate orders
  • Orders canceled before fulfillment
  • Refunded or returned orders
  • Chargebacks or fraudulent transactions
  • Any order determined by pediped® to violate the Affiliate Program Terms

pediped® reserves the right to review every referred order before approving commissions.

To receive payment, affiliates must provide accurate payment information in their affiliate account. Payment schedules and minimum payout thresholds, if applicable, will be listed in the Affiliate Dashboard.

Approved commissions will appear in the Commission section, and completed payouts will appear in the Payment section.

4. Marketing Materials

pediped® may provide approved marketing materials for affiliate use, including:

  • Banners
  • Logos
  • Product images
  • Promotional graphics
  • Seasonal campaign assets

Affiliates may use materials specifically provided or designated by pediped® for affiliate marketing purposes, subject to any instructions or restrictions provided with those materials.

The availability of content on pediped's website or social media accounts does not mean that the content is approved for affiliate use.

5. Content Ownership, UGC & Intellectual Property

All content created, published, or distributed by an affiliate in connection with the pediped® Affiliate Program must be original content created by the affiliate or content that the affiliate has the legal right and appropriate permission or license to use.

Affiliates may not copy, download, screen-record, reproduce, edit, republish, distribute, or otherwise use customer, influencer, creator, or User-Generated Content ("UGC") without appropriate permission or authorization from the content owner.

This includes, but is not limited to, photos, videos, Reels, Stories, captions, graphics, reviews, and other creative content appearing on:

  • pediped® Instagram
  • pediped® Facebook
  • pediped.com
  • TikTok
  • Pinterest
  • Customer or creator social media accounts
  • Other pediped® marketing or social channels

Content that a customer, influencer, or UGC creator has provided to pediped® or authorized pediped® to use does not automatically give pediped affiliates permission to use that content.

Affiliates must not represent another person's photo, video, testimonial, experience, child, family, or creative work as their own.

Affiliates are responsible for obtaining any necessary permission, consent, license, or other authorization before using third-party content.

Approved Content

Affiliates may use:

  • Their own original photos, videos, and other content
  • Content for which they have obtained appropriate permission or licensing rights
  • Official marketing materials specifically provided or designated by pediped® for affiliate use

If an affiliate is unsure whether a particular image, video, or other piece of content is authorized for affiliate use, the affiliate should contact pediped® before publishing it.

Unauthorized Content

If pediped® receives a complaint or determines that an affiliate may be using unauthorized content, pediped® may require the affiliate to remove the content immediately.

Failure to remove unauthorized content, repeated violations, or serious misuse of another creator's intellectual property may result in:

  • Suspension of the affiliate account
  • Termination from the Affiliate Program
  • Removal or reversal of commissions associated with non-compliant promotional activity, where permitted
  • Additional action when reasonably necessary to protect pediped®, its customers, creators, or intellectual property owners

pediped® reserves the right to review affiliate websites, social media accounts, and other publicly available promotional channels for compliance with these Terms.

6. Affiliate Network (If Enabled)

If the Network feature is available, affiliates may invite others to join the Program using their unique referral link.

Affiliates who successfully recruit new affiliates may earn network commissions based on pediped®'s current network commission structure.

Network commissions are subject to the same approval and payment policies as standard affiliate commissions.

7. Cookies & Tracking

pediped® uses cookies and similar technologies to track eligible affiliate referrals.

The applicable cookie duration is specified during affiliate registration or in the Affiliate Dashboard.

If a customer clicks an affiliate link or uses an assigned affiliate coupon code, qualifying purchases made during the applicable tracking period may be attributed to the affiliate according to the Program's attribution rules.

If a customer blocks, disables, or deletes cookies, referral tracking may be lost, and commissions cannot be guaranteed.

8. Prohibited Promotion Methods

Affiliates may not engage in:

  • Google Ads or paid search advertising using pediped® trademarks or brand keywords without written authorization
  • Unauthorized coupon or discount promotion
  • Spam or unsolicited marketing
  • Misleading, false, or deceptive advertising
  • Trademark or copyright infringement
  • Unauthorized use of customer, influencer, or creator UGC
  • Presenting another creator's content as the affiliate's own content
  • Fake transactions or fraudulent referrals
  • Self-referrals intended primarily to generate commissions
  • Incentivized purchases solely for earning commissions
  • Any activity that violates applicable laws, regulations, platform policies, or these Affiliate Program Terms

Violation of these requirements may result in suspension or termination from the Program and review of unpaid commissions.

9. Suspension or Removal from the Affiliate Program

pediped® reserves the right to suspend or terminate an affiliate account if we reasonably determine that the affiliate has violated these Terms & Conditions, engaged in fraudulent or deceptive activity, misused pediped® intellectual property, or used third-party content without proper authorization.

Depending on the nature of the violation, pediped® may request corrective action before suspension or termination.

Affiliates who wish to voluntarily leave the Affiliate Program may contact:

affiliate@pediped.com

10. Changes to the Affiliate Program

pediped® reserves the right to modify the Affiliate Program, including commission rates, qualifying transactions, promotional requirements, payment schedules, and these Terms & Conditions.

Material changes may be communicated through the Affiliate Dashboard, email, or other reasonable means.

Continued participation in the Program after updated terms become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms & Conditions.

11. Contact Us

If you have questions regarding the pediped® Affiliate Program, approved marketing materials, content usage, commissions, or these Terms & Conditions, please contact:

pediped® Affiliate Team
affiliate@pediped.com

Thank you for being part of the pediped® Affiliate Program. We appreciate your partnership and your commitment to promoting pediped® in an authentic, responsible, and respectful manner.
